releases.title: 32 new templates and a library change log
releases.summary: Templates now cover every stage from job description to exit certification, with notes for all 13 jurisdictions.

items.text: What's changed now opens on a Library changes tab: release notes for every change to the library, filterable by type and area, plus a live list of proposals the team accepted or implemented. The legal-change timeline moved to its own tab.
Process, policy and template pages have a Change history section listing each change that affected them, including linked templates and applied proposals.
Templates page grouped by lifecycle stage from recruiting to offboarding, with search, a format filter and a New marker on templates added in this release.
Template pages have an On this page menu, a Copy text button for pasting into Word or email, and letter-style layout for offer letters, warnings and other correspondence.
Search now covers template sections and the change log.

releases.title: Link and navigation fixes
releases.summary: Tested every page, link and in-page menu entry.

items.text: “On this page” menus now scroll the chosen section to just under the top bar and highlight the entry you clicked, including sections near the end of a page. Checked on 1,404 entries at two window sizes.
Replaced a broken eCFR link for 17 CFR 229.404 (related-person transactions) with its full address in the public-company section.
All 496 internal link targets resolve. 374 of 384 external source links load; the other 9 block automated checks and were not changed.

releases.title: Proposal applied to POL-16
releases.summary: First change made through the proposal workflow.

items.text: Removed clause 4.11 (candidate data privacy notice and retention) from POL-16 Recruitment & Selection. The agencies clause that was 4.12 is now 4.11. Candidate privacy and retention remain covered by TA-11 and POL-46.

releases.title: Home page layouts
releases.summary: Overview is the default home page, with Process map and Workspace as alternatives.

items.text: Process map home layout: all 97 processes on one screen by lifecycle stage, with checklist status.
Workspace home layout: checklist progress, items assigned to you, proposals awaiting review and upcoming filing deadlines.
Overview home layout restored the coverage map and hire-to-retire map.
